order: Global repeat IDs0..5; each phase visits repeat-major then pair_index0,1. Reverse the two users on odd global repeats. Matched serial/wave phases use identical order; every user is first three times across both halves.

policy.control: Audited TF32 FP32-storage folded serial beam50 engine; two generation calls per simultaneously ready pair.
policy.candidate: Native HF batch2 with50beams per request, two physical histories,100request-major suffix rows and per-request parent offsets. No prompt-prefix cache or BF16.
policy.both: CUDA matmul TF32 true, cuDNN TF32 false, FP32 weights/KV/logits, original full-vocabulary normalization, constraints, five scored transitions and termination.

timing.arrival: Both preprepared equal-length requests become ready at pair clock origin.
timing.completion: Monotonic host offsets after synchronization of each serial output or the whole wave. Each response includes within-pair waiting; both wave responses equal pair duration. No request admission wait before origin is modeled.
included: two-history prefill checks and prefix copies
timing.throughput: 2*number_of_pairs/sum(pair_duration_s); finite sequential pairs, not saturation/HTTP throughput.
timing.latency: Pair makespan and both request response offsets. Never label wave duration/2 as request latency.

budget.planning_note: Previously observed1094.222s four-phase setup/generation is context only. Batch100 compile/capture, physical batch2 prefill and audit are unmeasured; budget is a deadline, not a runtime guarantee.

screening.quality: Four users only; primary NDCG10/Hit10 once per user, all repetitions checked for stability. Candidate bit differences reported. No population parity or promotion.

mandatory_audit: actual GPU allocation plus global deadline and failure closure
all100beam rows mapped to their owning request with no cross-request parent
independent HF score clones and graph-output/arena storage ownership
candidate reverse-order and repeated-output stability, retained outputs
all5scored transitions, ancestry and original SID catalog validity
paired host completion timestamps including both serial outputs
allocated quality audit with one primary observation per user
